_note: PENDING — merge `messagingRecipients` into lib/i18n/locales/en.json alongside the
identical-keyed fr file, then delete both. Until then app/(tabs)/messages.tsx and
app/doctor/[id].tsx register this bundle at module load with i18n.addResourceBundle
(deep merge, no overwrite), so both languages work today and the merge is a no-op.
This is a DELTA. Everything already in the catalogue is reused rather than restated:
sendError / loadError / retry / careTeam, doctor.message* and opesCore.errors.*.
The relationship reasons a recipient carries ("You have an appointment here",
"On your care team") are NOT here on purpose: the server sends them already
translated as `basis_label`, from lang/{en,fr}/messaging_recipients.php. One rule,
one wording, and the phone cannot drift from what the API enforced.

_why: Copy ALREADY IN locales/en.json that this change made untrue. Overwrite the
existing values with these when merging — a false sentence left in the catalogue
is worse than a missing one, because nothing flags it.
All three said, in different words, that messaging requires an appointment. It
does not any more: the front desk is always available, and a clinician is
reachable on any of the five care relationships the server recognises.
corrections.messages.composeHelp: Write to a facility's front desk, or to a clinician already looking after you.
corrections.messages.composeNoAppointments: You have no appointment with an assigned provider yet. The facility's front desk can still answer.
corrections.messages.emptyBody: Ask a facility's front desk about hours, booking or results — or write to a clinician who is already looking after you.
corrections.doctor.messageNeedsAppointment: You can write to a clinician once they are looking after you. Until then, the facility's front desk can answer.

messagingRecipients.notEmergency: Not for emergencies. Messages are read during opening hours — for an emergency, call the facility or go there.
messagingRecipients.facilityHint: The front desk answers opening hours, booking, results and whether a medicine is in stock.
messagingRecipients.facilitySearchPlaceholder: Search a facility by name or city
messagingRecipients.facilityNoneTitle: No facility to write to yet
messagingRecipients.facilityNoneBody: Search for a facility above. Only facilities with a desk that answers messages appear here.
messagingRecipients.facilitySearchNoneBody: No facility with a messaging desk matches that. Try the town, or a shorter name.
messagingRecipients.clinicianHint: Only clinicians already looking after you.
messagingRecipients.clinicianNoneTitle: No clinician to write to yet
messagingRecipients.clinicianNoneBody: You can write to a clinician once one is looking after you — after an appointment, or once you are on their care team. The facility's front desk can help in the meantime.
messagingRecipients.clinicianUnavailableHint: {{name}} has no inbox for this yet. Write to {{facility}} and the desk will pass it on.
messagingRecipients.loadError: Could not load who you can write to.
messagingRecipients.doctorNoRelationshipBody: You can write to {{name}} once they are looking after you — book an appointment, and messaging opens with it. Until then the facility's front desk can answer.
messagingRecipients.doctorUnreachableBody: {{name}} is involved in your care, but has no inbox that can receive this yet. The front desk reads its messages and will pass it on.
